name: The Ghoul King
visual_description: A malformed, half-melted creature bearing a twisted crown. Its eyes are unequal, its mouth too full. It’s regal in the way a statue is regal—still, cracked, false.
existential_reflection: I outlived humanity’s kings. I crowned myself with control. But in that throne, I found only mimicry. Mizontresh approached not as subject—but as mirror. It wore no crown. I bowed.
